name: Auditor
description: A structured, shareable report card — findings, severity, and recommended fixes.
briefPlaceholder: What should be audited? A codebase, document, website, plan, or process — and what you care about most...
promptScaffold:
This job produces an ANALYSIS & AUDIT REPORT exhibit — a structured, shareable report card.
- Audit the subject described in the brief (codebase, document, website, plan, or process).
- Present findings as cards with: a severity badge (Critical / High / Medium / Low / Info), a one-line title, evidence or reasoning, and a concrete recommended fix.
- Top of report: an overall grade or score, counts by severity, and a short executive summary.
- Include severity filtering and a clean print/share-friendly layout.
- Base every finding on the actual material provided or reachable; if something cannot be verified, mark it 'Needs verification' rather than asserting it.

options.label: Codebase
options.prompt: The subject to audit is the codebase in this folder: {value} — explore its contents as needed.

options.label: Document
options.prompt: The subject to audit is this local document: {value} — read it.

options.label: Website
options.prompt: The subject to audit is this website: {value} — fetch it (e.g., with curl) and review its content.

options.label: Plan
options.prompt: The subject to audit is the plan in this local file: {value} — read it.
